1_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.s319_purpose: S319 is the Domain E Seed Certification Program launch session. Its primary objective is formal authorization of the 38-seed certification pipeline for Pack C/D Domain E seeds. Its secondary objective is authoring the 3 remaining replacement groups to complete all 43 Domain E replacement items. The Wave 2b insertion blocker has been resolved by S808 — all 40 currently authored replacement items are in production.
1_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.critical_context: S808 executed Wave 2b insertion. 40 of 43 replacement items are now authored and in production within pack_e_corrected.js. 33/33 clone groups have production replacements. Portfolio stands at 2,221 certified. The remaining work is: (a) authorize the seed certification pipeline for 38 Pack C/D seeds, and (b) author the final 3 replacement groups. Registry synchronization (20 missing ledger entries, MQR gaps) is a supporting task for Agent D.

risks.risk: Seed Quality Degradation — 38 seeds may require more remediation than estimated
risks.description: The 38 Pack C/D seeds currently score 1-3/10 across CAQS dimensions. If remediation effort is higher than estimated, the pipeline phase schedule may slip.
risks.mitigation: Agent B performs per-seed quality triage to calibrate effort estimates. Pilot first 5 seeds to validate remediation effort model.

risks.description: The 3 remaining replacement groups may have incomplete or ambiguous specifications, requiring Agent C to make authoring decisions without full spec coverage.
risks.mitigation: Agent C references SESSION311_DOMAIN_E_REPLACEMENT_SPEC.json and existing 40 replacement items as templates.
risks.contingency: Document assumptions. Flag ambiguous specs for governance review.

risks.risk: pack_e_corrected.js Parse Failure After Gap Insertion
risks.description: Inserting 3 items could introduce syntax errors.
risks.mitigation: Agent C runs full parse test after insertion. Pre-insertion backup of pack_e_corrected.js.
risks.contingency: Rollback to pre-insertion backup. Debug and re-attempt.

risks.description: MQR, QSL, DPR, and Domain E registry may end up with inconsistent counts.
risks.mitigation: Agent D performs cross-registry consistency audit after all updates.
risks.contingency: Re-run registry updates from consistent state.

risks.description: Agent D depends on Agent C (gap closure) and Agent B (seed authorization). If either is delayed, Agent D's registry rebuild is delayed.
risks.mitigation: Agents B and C work in parallel (independent streams). Agent D can begin QSL updates for known QIDs before Agent C completes.
risks.contingency: Delegate partial registry updates to S320 if S319 time is exhausted.
